## Error alerts
Runs automatically when the report or command workflows fail after their retries.
Sends the owner a Telegram alert and writes a row to mr_error_log.
Note: n8n only fires this for real (production) runs, not manual test runs.

parameters.query: insert into mr_error_log (workflow, node, message, created_at) values ($1, $2, $3, $4)
